== Summary ==
Still from the SWCCG documentary filmed at the [[2018 U.S. National Championship]] in Atlanta, posted by the filmmaker (Thekillerkiwi) as a preview.

* '''Event:''' [[2018 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2018-08-01
* '''Identification:''' the people are not named in the post.
